rubricScores.criterion: Identified MSB3277 for System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource in DeviceConfigClient, specifically in the net8.0 target framework build

The investigation was methodical but inefficient (87 tool calls, many returning empty or oversized results), and some conclusions aren't fully verified against binlog data as requested.
